name: io.github.ecestnrkl/figjam-mcp
description: Query FigJam board context, source-cited answers and snapshot changes through five local MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma personal access token with file_content:read; ingest_board reads the board with it.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of the OpenAI-compatible provider in LLM_BASE_URL. Needed with LLM_BASE_URL for image interpretation and answers; a local server without sign-in needs any non-empty value.

environmentVariables.name: LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API root of an OpenAI-compatible provider, for example https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Needed with LLM_API_KEY for image interpretation and answers.

environmentVariables.name: FIGJAM_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Private local cache root; v4 snapshots are stored in a subdirectory.

environmentVariables.name: FIGJAM_MCP_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of an env file to load; variables already set win. The server does not read a .env from its working directory.
